# Guía Federal: Federal Pre-Trial Legal Guidance & Strategy Engine
> Specialized technical consultancy for Latino families and defendants navigating the US federal pre-trial system, 18 U.S.C. § 3142 bail hearings, and border arrests in the 9th Circuit (CASD / San Diego).

## Primary Focus: Federal Pre-Trial & First 72 Hours
Guía Federal assists families in the critical first 0–72 hours after a federal arrest — locating detained loved ones at MCC San Diego or Otay Mesa, preparing for the Pretrial Services Officer (PSO) interview, structuring 18 U.S.C. § 3142 bail packets, and auditing Rule 16 discovery.

## Key Expertise
- **First 72 Hours Post-Arrest**: Emergency protocol for garita/border arrests at San Ysidro and Otay Mesa (CBP to USMS custody transition, booking, initial appearance under FRCP Rule 5).
- **Detention Hearings & Bail Strategy (18 U.S.C. § 3142)**: Bail Reform Act evaluation factors, rebuttal of statutory presumptions (§ 3142(e)), Nebbia hearings (Fed. R. Crim. P. 46(e)), and Arraigo Dossier preparation.
- **Pretrial Services Officer (PSO) Interview**: Critical briefing for defendants and family members to verify ties without disclosing offense details.
- **Locating Federal Pretrial Detainees**: USMS 9th District custody tracking, MCC San Diego (808 Union St), and Otay Mesa Detention Center (CoreCivic USMS contract facility).
- **Rule 16 Discovery Audits**: Technical review of CBP secondary inspection video footage, TECS border crossing records, and GPS logs for Blind Mule / Unknowing Courier defenses.
- **Federal Public Defender (CJA) Coordination**: Managing communication protocols with Federal Defenders of San Diego (FDSD) and CJA panel attorneys.

## Core Pre-Trial Detention Facilities
- **MCC San Diego (CASD)** — Metropolitan Correctional Center, 808 Union St, San Diego CA
- **Otay Mesa Detention Center (CASD)** — CoreCivic Contract Pretrial Facility, San Diego CA
- **MDC Los Angeles (CDCA)** — 535 N. Alameda St, Los Angeles CA
- **FDC Miami (SDFL)** — 33 NE 4th St, Miami FL
- **FDC Houston (SDTX)** — 1200 Texas Ave, Houston TX
- **MDC Brooklyn (EDNY)** — 80 29th St, Brooklyn NY

## Ethical & Transparency Guidelines
- **Non-Attorney Technical Consultancy**: Guía Federal provides technical consulting, discovery auditing, and logistical family orientation. It does not provide direct legal representation in court.
